name: Castra Praetoria
type: barracks; castrum; archaeological site; ancient Roman structure
text: Castra Praetoria were the ancient barracks (castra) of the Praetorian Guard of Imperial Rome.

depictions.name: Castra Praetoria
depictions.text: The Castra Praetoria (English: Praetorian Barracks) was a fortified military barracks in Rome, incorporated into the north-eastern edge of the Aurelian Walls. It was originally constructed to house the Praetorian Guard, the official bodyguards of the Roman Emperors. Its remains survive to this day.
